correctness.rationale: The block Laplacian decomposes orthogonally into 0,N,p,q eigenvalues and their full eigenspaces. An exact two-coordinate PBH argument shows same-side pairs always fail, opposite-side pairs activate at least three spectral levels for p≠q, and balanced pairs admit exactly the two stated resonance equalities. Strict convexity makes a single scalar value impossible at three distinct levels. One unactuated coordinate activates three levels, so N-1 inputs always work when h>0. Cubic factorizations, monotone derivatives and positive scalar bounds establish the exact RK4 roots and positivity. The standalone verifier passed 100 exact-rational transition matrices, 1884 exact Kalman ranks and 1584 two-uncontrolled-coordinate tests; finite checks do not replace the proof.
